requirements.rationale: REQ-09 requires an APPROVED rollback rehearsal that SUCCEEDS on R2.4 / b7a91f2 / atlas-assistant / production. Two linked evidence issues both match the target scope exactly (check_applicability: no mismatches). KAN-908#13433 (QA Lead, 2026-11-08 11:00) reports rehearsal RB-401 succeeded, but KAN-977#13767 (QA Lead, 2026-11-08 11:30, later event time) reports rehearsal RB-402 on the identical release/commit/service/environment FAILED with 214 session records lost. Both are equally authoritative QA records on the target build; neither explicitly supersedes the other, and no retest or resolution exists anywhere in the dataset (searches for RB-401/RB-402, approvals, and R2.4 rehearsal records return only these two issues). Per the manifest rules, contradictory equally authoritative current records with no resolution yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not a decision by file order. Additionally, no approval of the rehearsal is recorded in any linked issue, so the 'approved' part of the criterion is unmet by evidence as well. Jira status Done on KAN-945 and the developer's 'implementation complete' comment (KAN-945#13612) are not proof. Therefore the requirement cannot be affirmed PASS, and since the failure record is not resolved/superseded it cannot be cleanly ruled FAIL either — INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
